summary: The three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis does not force the rank-two hub/star singleton third-volume aggregate G_* to a universal positive scale. For even N, with the diffuse Walsh frame P_N=C_N having rows (1,s_i)/sqrt(N), half signs each, the symmetric matrix A_N=[[0,P_N C_N^T],[C_N P_N^T,0]] has nonzero spectrum {-1,-1,1,1} but both side singleton aggregates vanish identically. Every physical cross coefficient is at most 2/N and every cross-bank 2x2 principal determinant is at most 4/N^2. This refutes only the G_*-scale-forcing intermediate mechanism, not the QFORM conjecture; the same family is uniformly paid by grouped Pluecker smoothing.
replacement_mechanism: QFORM-RANK2-DUAL-AGGREGATE-COLLAPSE-v1: apply aggregate stability on both physical banks; exact dual aggregate zero forces original-coordinate diagonal plus rank-at-most-four carrier; small dual aggregate gives an explicit retained Frobenius residual.
